meta.name: fjord_rivals
meta.prompt: Two rival fishing villages on opposite shores of a narrow fjord, one of stone and one of timber, joined only by a rope ferry.

programs.brief: A heavy wooden-and-iron rope ferry rig spanning the narrow water gap between two rocky landings, with thick guide ropes, winch capstans on both shores, and a flat timber ferry barge held mid-crossing.

tokens.terrain: a deep, narrow fjord with steep opposing shores separated by open water
tokens.region_stone_village: era medieval, wealth 0.4, formality 0.25, urbanForm hillside, ground stepped; materialTheme temperate_timber; prefer archetypes cottage, watchtower, smokehouse, warehouse; props dock, fish_drying_rack; a rugged village constructed from rough-hewn stone and slate on the rocky bluffs
tokens.region_timber_village: era medieval, wealth 0.4, formality 0.2, urbanForm hillside, ground stepped; materialTheme boreal_pine; formPacks ["nordic_viking"]; prefer archetypes cottage, boat_shed, fish_drying_rack, smokehouse; props dock, rowboat; a timber-framed fishing village of dark logs, planking, and pine shingles
tokens.infra: rope_ferry line spanning the narrow water gap between stone landing and timber landing
tokens.rivalry: bitterly competitive fishing factions facing each other across the channel
